items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: That's how Joey and all them got all their touches on their trumpets.

ctx.x: Just like yourself. What about clarinet and saxophone? How'd you learn that?

Now, when we go over to Los Angeles, the fellas always liked to play piano. That's how Joey and all them got all their touches on their trumpets. In my style, they liked to play piano. They said, you know something? You ought to be playing a clarinet and saxophone, like Johnny Dot would tell me. Johnny would always tell me, you ought to be playing this clarinet. I used to play clarinet parts on my violin. Then Johnny would play straight. Just like little George Lewis, the same way. Take a little George Lewis.…
